name: AgentOS Linux MVP
goal: Build the first executable slice of an Agent-first OS environment on Linux: agentd boot path, terminal-first control plane, semantic capability runtime, audit journal, diff/rollback, and recovery semantics.
non_goals: Do not write a new kernel for MVP.
Do not embed LLM behavior inside kernel space.
Do not expose arbitrary root shell as the default tool interface.
Do not productize Firecracker, seL4/Genode, multi-tenant isolation, or HA governance in MVP.
open_decisions: 首发形态选择开发者 VM、Cloud VM，还是双轨。
MVP 目标发行版是否固定为 Debian/Ubuntu。
MVP 是否允许外部 LLM，或先强制 local-only/stub 模式。
首个真实 Runbook 是 nginx 恢复、仓库自举，还是云 VM 诊断。
primary_acceptance: A bootable Linux image reaches an interactive terminal-first agentd surface.
All write operations produce a reviewable diff before commit.
Every side-effecting operation is recorded through EffectPrepared -> EffectObserved -> CommitSealed or RollbackPending.
No default arbitrary shell capability exists in normal mode.
Read-only diagnostics run with namespace/cgroup/seccomp constraints and zero persistent side effects.
